name: Mark Meek

bio.statement: His official biography says Meek was elected to the State Senate for District 20 in 2022 and previously served in the Oregon House.
bio.excerpt: He was elected to the State Senate by the people of District 20 in 2022.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Meek lists his occupation as small business owner and state senator, and owner of Avid Real Estate Executives, LLC.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Small Business Owner; State Senator Occupational Background: Owner, Avid Real Estate Executives, LLC

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

bio.statement: Meek lists a B.S. in management/CIS from Park College.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: B.S. Management/CIS – Park College

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

bio.statement: Meek lists the Oregon House, Clackamas County Planning Commission and Economic Development Commission, and U.S. Air Force service as a staff sergeant, 1983-1990.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Oregon House of Representatives; Clackamas County Planning Commission; Clackamas County Economic Development Commission Military Experience: Staff Sergeant (Security Police), U.S. Air Force (1983-1990)

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: In a July 2025 OPB interview, Meek said he would support a transportation package that helps pay for maintenance, bridge repairs and transit.
positions.excerpt: I would support a package that helps pay for maintenance, bridge repairs and transit

source.publisher: OPB

positions.statement: A supporter quoted in Meek's statement says he will lower costs and make life more affordable.
positions.excerpt: lower costs and make life more affordable

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Meek's statement quotes a supporter crediting him with stopping tolling on I-205.
positions.excerpt: Mark stopped tolling on I-205, saving families thousands of dollars each year.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Meek's statement says he believes high-quality, affordable healthcare should be available to everyone.
positions.excerpt: Mark believes high-quality, affordable healthcare should be available to everyone.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: A parent quoted in Meek's statement says he will improve schools, raise graduation rates and keep families safe.
positions.excerpt: Mark Meek is the only candidate I trust to improve schools, raise graduation rates, and keep our families safe.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42
